name: Venom Confuse Lock!
description_md:
Hi! I'm IlEmperatore, a Spanish YouTuber who dedicates his channel exclusively to share Marvel Champions content since the game came out: https://www.youtube.com/ilemperatore

The idea of this deck is so simple: 10 cards to confuse the enemy, like [Concussive Blow](/card/05031) ["Think Fast!"](/card/19031) [Behind Enemy Lines](/card/20002) and [Sonic Rifle](/card/20015) and 6/11 cards to deal a lot of damage to a confused enemy, like [Scare Tactic](/card/20012) [Swift Retribution](/card/15014) or the mentioned [Concussive Blow](/card/05031) or [Sonic Rifle](/card/20015).

It's an agressive deck at the same time that you can turn when you want to heal yourself with basic 4 recuperation and 3 more with [Project Rebirth 2.0](/card/20007).

So awesome deck. Take care! :D
